players.product: Lithography equipment for advanced packaging and package substrates: UX-5 steppers, direct imaging (DI) lithography equipment and DLT maskless lithography systems

quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (April-September 2025): net sales JPY 81,425 million (down 4.9%), operating profit JPY 4,014 million (down 6.0%), ordinary profit JPY 5,032 million (down 7.6%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 240 million (down 89.6%); the average USD rate was 146 yen, 8 yen stronger for the yen than a year earlier. Other segments' sales: Visual Imaging JPY 38,077 million (down 3.0%; segment profit JPY 1,805 million vs a loss a year earlier), Life Science JPY 3,288 million (up 7.8%), Photonics Solution JPY 4,976 million (down 2.8%). Group R&D spending in the half was JPY 6,509 million
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 81,425 million (-4.9%); operating profit JPY 4,014 million (-6.0%); R&D JPY 6,509 million

quarterly_data.signal: Industrial Process segment, first half (April-September 2025): sales JPY 34,434 million (down 8.4%), segment profit JPY 2,048 million (down 60.9%). Management states direct imaging (DI) lithography sales increased as PC and smartphone end demand gradually recovered, while projection lithography (stepper) sales fell: demand from generative-AI semiconductors in advanced package substrates is trending up, but weak demand from existing data centers kept customer investment restrained or postponed. Profit fell on lower sales, expanded upfront investment in lithography equipment including DLT, and inventory valuation losses from the delayed recovery in lithography demand. Exposure lamp sales were flat (installed tools running steadily, supported by generative-AI semiconductor demand, offset by the stronger yen); EUV light source maintenance revenue for EUV lithography mask inspection declined
